query: Under the RBI KYC Directions, who is the beneficial owner when the customer is a company?
answer: The beneficial owner is the natural person(s) who, whether acting alone or together, or through one or more juridical persons, has/have a controlling ownership interest or who exercises control through other means [1].

query: What minimum haircut applies to Level 2A assets in a bank's stock of high-quality liquid assets, and what is the cap on Level 2 assets?
answer: The minimum haircut applicable to Level 2A assets in a bank's stock of high-quality liquid assets is 15%, and the cap on Level 2 assets is no more than 40% of the overall stock of HQLA [3]. Additionally, a minimum higher haircut of 20% must be applied to any additional Level 2A assets held beyond the 40% cap [1, 2].

query: With how many life insurers may a Corporate Agent (Life) have arrangements?
answer: A Corporate Agent (Life) may have arrangements with a maximum of nine life insurers [1(a)].

What measures are required regarding cross-border currency transportation under the FATF cash couriers guidelines?
answer: Countries are required to have measures in place to detect the physical cross-border transportation of currency and bearer negotiable instruments, which can include a declaration or disclosure system. Additionally, competent authorities must have the legal authority to stop or restrain such items if they are suspected to be related to certain criminal activities [1]. These measures aim to prevent the financing of terrorist activities and money laundering through such transportation [2].

query: What specific declarations regarding previous regulatory registrations must key individuals submit under the IRDAI (Registration of Corporate Agent) Regulations, 2015?
answer: Key individuals must submit a declaration of Fit & Proper criteria from Principal Officer, Directors, and Managing Partners (separately for each person) as part of the application, according to the Fit and Proper Form as per annexure 1 [1].

query: How frequently are domestic structural liquidity statements and overseas branch reports required to be submitted to the Reserve Bank of India?
answer: Domestic structural liquidity statements (SLS) are required to be reported on a fortnightly basis, while overseas branch operations reports are submitted on a monthly basis to the Reserve Bank of India [2][3].

query: How must a bank proceed when local laws and regulations abroad prohibit the implementation of the Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Know Your Customer) Directions, 2025?
answer: When local laws and regulations abroad prohibit the implementation of the Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Asset Liability Management) Directions, 2025, the bank shall bring the same to the notice of the relevant authorities [1].

Under regulation 32 of the SEBI Stock Brokers Regulations, how is the Board empowered to handle auditor appointment for a stock broker?
answer: Under regulation 32(1) of the SEBI Stock Brokers Regulations, the Board may appoint a qualified auditor to inspect or investigate into the books of account or the affairs of the stock broker in addition to inspections by the inspecting authority [1].
